actualPrompt: Create ONE standalone reusable map prop P08, a small rectangular leafy-vegetable garden bed. Input1 is geometry only: preserve that high orthographic overhead oblique projection and rectangular ground footprint, long edges screen -28.486degrees, short edges +55.406degrees, verticals vertical. Approximate physical candidate 2.6m long,1.6m wide,0.55m maximum foliage height; low edging only about .12m. Replace green guide circles with THREE tidy parallel rows of leafy vegetables, five modest plants per row, varied natural leaf turns, readable dark-and-mid-green leaves, natural soil gaps between plants, muted brown cultivated soil contained inside one low simple weathered timber rectangular frame. Geometry circles are spacing hints, not literal circles. No huge leaves or shrub/tree crowns. Input2 is local STYLE/PALETTE reference from approved Japanese urban anime painted map: soft hand-painted light/shade, summarized organic color planes, natural neutral daytime, slightly darker rich greens, warm-gray wood, muted brown soil. Do not copy its house/road/farm layout. New original small garden detail in that style. Not photoreal product photography, no glossy plastic, no thick black cartoon outlines, not flat icon or pixel art. Complete frame and all four ground corners inside generous transparent margin. ONLY bed and its finite internal soil and vegetables, outside edge truly transparent; no surrounding lawn, ground slab, floor, shadows cloud, atmosphere, halo, road, people, car, tools, labels, text, logo, sky or scenery. No background gradient or white rectangle. Remove all guide markers and text. Upper-left daylight, restrained local shading inside object only. One object, no multi-view panel.
